changeSet.author: system-fix
changeSet.comment: Consolida registros duplicados sumando montos y eliminando excedentes.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_consolidated AS SELECT MIN(id) as keep_id, bill_account_id, household_id, year, month, SUM(amount) as total_amount FROM bill_account_amounts GROUP BY bill_account_id, household_id, year, month HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
UPDATE bill_account_amounts b SET amount = t.total_amount FROM tmp_consolidated t WHERE b.id = t.keep_id;

DELETE FROM bill_account_amounts b USING tmp_consolidated t WHERE b.bill_account_id = t.bill_account_id AND b.household_id = t.household_id AND b.year = t.year AND b.month = t.month AND b.id <> t.keep_id;
